description: Track one parcel: current status (접수/집화/이동중/배송출발/배송완료/배송실패/수령대기/이상), last event, full event history with KST times. Carrier can be a Korean or English name (CJ대한통운, 우체국, 한진, 롯데, 로젠, 쿠팡, 야마토, DHL…) or a Delivery Tracker id like kr.cjlogistics. 운송장 1건을 조회합니다. Use for '이 주문 어디쯤이야?' or to confirm delivery before a settlement/CS reply. Needs carrier + trackingNumber; DELIVERY_TRACKER_CLIENT_ID/SECRET env.

carrier.description: Carrier name or id, e.g. CJ대한통운, 우체국, kr.hanjin
